in_marathi.name: Navghan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे New, Fresh, Young
in_marathi.long_meaning: Navghan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Navghan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'nav', meaning new or fresh. The suffix 'ghan' is derived from the word 'ghana', meaning dense, strong or powerful. Together, Navghan can be interpreted as a new, young, and powerful individual.
